objective: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

description: The Gadgetzan Water Company of Gadgetzan, Tanaris will pay a high bounty for the head of Caliph Scorpidsting, leader of the Wastewander outlaws.  His crimes include:
Bring proof of Caliph Scorpidsting's demise to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle for an immediate reward!
progress: Yes <class>, I am an official of the Gadgetzan Water Company. What can I assist you with?
completion: Finally - justice is served! You have struck a mighty blow against those vile nomads! With Scorpidsting's demise, this might be just the thing to finally push those squatters off of Gadgetzan's water wells!
By the authority of the Gadgetzan Water Company, I gladly award you with this bounty. You've done a great service for us all.
